\chapter{Evaluation}
The setup of Section~\ref{sec:setup} is used for all specimens.
The rig in Figure~\ref{fig:rig} applies the spectrum.
Growth follows Equation~\ref{equation:paris}, and Table~\ref{results} lists the fitted rates.

\chapter{Evaluation}
